description: This file defines the I18NHelper class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for internationalization support such as translating strings and setting language preferences.

classes.name: I18NHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing internationalization functions like translation and language setting within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the container.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Translates a key into the current language, optionally receiving parameters and a language code.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Translates a source string into the current language, optionally with parameters and a language code.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the translator's language to the specified language code.
